svg.title: Lifecycle tiers, a geo copy and a retention lock
svg.desc: In the lake account, block blobs under raw/ move from Hot to Cool 30 days after their last change, to Cold at 90 and Archive at 180; blobs under curated/ are deleted at 365 days. The records account is RA-GRS, so a read-only copy sits in the paired region behind a secondary endpoint, and its evidence container keeps every blob unchangeable for a day under an unlocked retention policy.
